Static owner: hosted composition seam carrying already-selected provider ports. Dynamic path: startup injects those ports into canonical IAM, Vault, Session, and protocol owners; this file neither evaluates entitlement nor adopts credential material. Evidence: crates/control/awaken-credential-vault/src/repo.rs and the canonical downstream owners.

Static owner: serializable model-request audit projection and retry counter. Dynamic path: already-decided request facts are lowered into audit events without admitting a model request or mutating Run state; the scanner's StateChanged term occurs only below cfg(test). Evidence: crates/contract/awaken-agent-contract/src/audit/run_event.rs.

Static owner: Coordinator assembly of existing lifecycle delivery ports. Dynamic path: committed lifecycle facts flow through CompositeLifecycleFactDelivery to the existing WebhookOutboxNotifier; no lifecycle transition, retry, or durable-outbox decision is reimplemented here. Evidence: crates/contract/awaken-session-contract/src/lifecycle.rs and crates/server/awaken-webhook-managed/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: Managed protocol fixtures and scenario helpers. Dynamic path: the module is reachable only through the exact cfg(any(test, feature = test-support)) declaration and never enters the default product graph. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-protocol-managed/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: dispatch-admission conformance cases. Dynamic path: the tooling-only testkit includes this exact file into its test fixture library; no product crate owns or invokes it. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-run-ingress-testkit/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: reusable ingress fakes and fixture constructors. Dynamic path: the tooling-only testkit includes this exact file for conformance execution; it is absent from the product runtime graph. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-run-ingress-testkit/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: operation-claim conformance cases. Dynamic path: the tooling-only testkit includes this exact file to drive implementations under test; production dispatch never calls it. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-run-ingress-testkit/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: recovery-credential conformance cases. Dynamic path: the tooling-only testkit includes this exact file to exercise claimed recovery; it does not resolve credentials in production. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-run-ingress-testkit/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: dispatch-reservation conformance cases. Dynamic path: the tooling-only testkit includes this exact file to assert store behavior; it does not reserve product work itself. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-run-ingress-testkit/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: pending Session-message conformance cases. Dynamic path: the tooling-only testkit includes this exact file to drive store implementations under test; it is not a production message port. Evidence: crates/server/awaken-run-ingress-testkit/src/lib.rs.

Static owner: field-preserving adapter between Session outcome ports and the Host outcome controller.
